id: # The flag colour of each faction (docs/GRAPHICS.md, "Faction colours"). Row N is the colour of force N. The spec gives no colours, so this table is a choice of the clone.
# The style follows the faction colours of the 三國志 series and of Total War: Three Kingdoms: 曹操 blue, 劉備 green, 孫 red, 袁紹 gold, 公孫瓚 white, 呂布 black.
# The rulers of the same family name have far colours: 劉備 green, 劉璋 sky blue, 劉表 pink, 劉繇 orange. The note names the ruler of force N in 群雄割據 (194).
# The colours are flat and of a medium to high saturation, so that they show on the green, brown and blue map. Each pair of rows is at least 60 apart (faction_colours.h).
